ai.title: --git stage replaces --auto-git
ai.summary: CLI git flag changed from boolean --auto-git to value-based --git stage. stagePatches in common/util/git.ts stages files from last message via git add, replacing prior auto-commit logic. New types.ts defines GitCommand and CliOptions. Backend retry error message updated to 'system's a bit overwhelmed'.

ai.title: Add Loops signup event tracking
ai.summary: Added Loops API integration to send signup events on user creation. Includes new LOOPS_API_KEY environment variable and fetch call to https://app.loops.so/api/v1/events/send. Scope: web/src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/auth-options.ts, web/src/env.mjs.

eli5.text: The service can now quietly register that you signed up by telling a tool called Loops. When you create an account, the system sends a message to Loops with your email and name so the team can track signups; if that message ever fails, it won't stop your account from being created. This works today for anyone who signs up through the main sign-in flow, and you wouldn't see anything different on your screen.

ai.title: Apply referral credits before invoice finalization
ai.summary: Referral credits now apply to Stripe usage meters during `invoice.created` events, not just `invoice.paid`. New `handleInvoiceCreated` function in `web/src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts` injects negative credit values into `stripeServer.billing.meterEvents` to reduce billable amounts before finalization. Logic extracted from `handleSubscriptionChange` into `getTotalReferralCreditsForCustomer` for reuse. `backend/src/billing/message-cost-tracker.ts` cleaned up with minor syntax fixes and removed commented debug code. `package.json` adds `start-studio` script.

eli5.text: When a company bills its subscribers, referral credits (like rewards from telling friends) are now taken off the bill at the very start, while the bill is still being put together, instead of only after it is already finished and paid. Before, a member could see their first draft bill that did not yet show the credit, and the discount would only appear later; now the reduced amount shows up on the first version of the bill they (or their finance team) sees. This applies to anyone Stripe bills for metered usage, so the final amount you are charged reflects those credits from the beginning. Behind the scenes the same credit total is reused for both this early discount and existing subscription changes, and the developer tools got a couple of small cleanups and an extra helper command.

ai.title: Stripe webhook adds referral credit note to invoice
ai.summary: web/src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts now calls stripeServer.invoices.update after adding the referral credit line item. Sets invoice description to 'Referral bonus: ${referralCredits} credits deducted'. Scope limited to Stripe webhook invoice creation handler.

eli5.text: When a payment invoice is created automatically through Stripe, the system now adds a brief note to that invoice explaining that a referral bonus was applied as a credit. A small amount of accompanying code was removed elsewhere to make this explanation work, keeping the change minimal. The note reads something like 'Referral bonus: X credits deducted,' so anyone reviewing the invoice, such as a customer service representative or an accountant, can immediately see why the total was reduced by that credit. This applies only to invoices generated during the automatic renewal process handled through Stripe's webhook system.
